# SampaUI Agent Guide

SampaUI is a Blade-first UI package for Laravel 13+, Livewire 4+, Tailwind CSS 4, AlpineJS and Bootstrap Icons. It is intended for corporate, SaaS and internal applications with a premium, restrained visual style.

Official docs to consult when changing package, Laravel or Livewire behavior:
- https://laravel.com/docs/13.x/documentation
- https://laravel.com/docs/13.x/packages
- https://livewire.laravel.com/docs/4.x/quickstart
- https://livewire.laravel.com/docs/4.x/forms

## Installation

```bash
composer require sampaui/sampaui
php artisan sampaui:install
npm run build
```

The installer publishes config/assets and imports:

```css
@import "../../vendor/sampaui/sampaui/dist/sampaui.css";
```

```js
import "../../vendor/sampaui/sampaui/dist/sampaui.js";
```

When bundling Livewire manually, load SampaUI statically before `Livewire.start()` so Alpine controllers are available on the first render. Do not defer this import with `import()`.

## Public API Rules

- Component namespace: `sampaui`.
- Component tag format: `<x-sampaui::{slug} />`.
- All components must accept `class=""` customization.
- Form components must preserve `wire:model` and Livewire modifiers on the real control.
- Interactive components must preserve `wire:click`, `wire:navigate`, `x-*` and valid HTML attributes.
- Text fields and form triggers use `border-secondary/20`; checkbox, radio and upload controls use `border-secondary/40`.
- Prefer official semantic tokens over custom hex classes.
- Use Bootstrap Icons only, with `bi bi-{name}` classes.

## Theme Tokens

Official tokens:

```txt
primary, secondary, accent, danger, light, surface, success, warning, info, purple, muted, border, text
```

Common classes:

```txt
bg-primary, text-secondary, border-border, bg-accent/10, focus:ring-primary/20
```

## Component Registry

The source of truth for agents and docs is:

```txt
resources/metadata/components.php
```

The static export is:

```txt
docs/registry/components.json
```

Use this command to export:

```bash
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=json --path=docs/registry/components.json
```

## Agent Commands

```bash
php artisan sampaui:about
php artisan sampaui:list
php artisan sampaui:list --category=form
php artisan sampaui:doctor
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=json
php artisan sampaui:docs-export --format=markdown
```

## API Notes

- `select` usa combobox Alpine com `x-modelable`, aceita `options`, `value`, `placeholder`, `emptyText`, `required` e preserva um `<select>` real oculto para formularios e Livewire.
- `table` e a listagem simples. Para novas tabelas com busca, use `table-search`; as props avancadas antigas do `table` continuam disponiveis por compatibilidade.
- `dropdown` aceita `align`, `width` e `placement`; use `placement="top"` em menus nas ultimas linhas de tabelas ou containers com rolagem para evitar corte visual.
- Campos centrais aceitam `hint`, `error`, `state`, `required`, `readonly`, `loading` e `loading-target`, associando label e feedback por ARIA ao controle real; erros sao descobertos por `name` ou pelo caminho de `wire:model`.
- `select` usa `x-modelable` para sincronizar valor e label com Livewire; `select-multiple` preserva o controle nativo. Ambos suportam teclado e limpeza com `clearable`.
- `button` permite que `class=""` substitua utilitarios visuais conflitantes, incluindo cor, hover, espacamento, largura, raio, sombra e tipografia; estados desabilitados preservam `cursor-not-allowed`.
- `accordion` aceita `items` com `title`, `content` e `open`; use `multiple="false"` quando somente uma seção puder permanecer aberta. O padrão `true` preserva múltiplas seções abertas.
- `card` usa `overflow="visible"` por padrao para que DatePicker, selects, dropdowns e popovers absolutos possam abrir integralmente. Use `overflow="hidden"` somente quando o recorte for intencional.
- `dropdown` usa portal no `body` com `position: fixed`, alinhamento pelo trigger, camada segura para Modal e Drawer e reposicionamento em scroll/resize. O menu abre acima automaticamente quando necessario.
- `date-picker` usa `text-slate-600` como cor neutra do trigger, com valor e icone herdando essa cor. `class=""` pode sobrescrever o visual do trigger.
- `file-upload` aceita `max-size`, `retry` e `chunk-size`; progresso e cancelamento integram os eventos de upload do Livewire. Os object URLs de preview sao liberados no destroy e em `beforeunload` protegido; crop e reordenacao ainda nao fazem parte da API.
- `modal`, `drawer` e `dropdown` controlam foco, Esc e click-outside; `close-on-escape` e `close-on-outside` sao configuraveis.
- `sidebar` usa largura expandida de `18rem`, sem faixa externa; recebe a marca somente por `logo-src`, usa estado ativo circular igual ao hover e link de saida outline danger sem sombra.
- `toast` usa fila e limite de visiveis, pausa timer com foco e aceita `variant="soft|solid|outline"` e `size="sm|md|lg"`.
- `table` aceita `sticky-header`, `mobile-cards`, skeleton com `loading`, empty state premium e slots `toolbar`, `filters`, `actions`, `head`, `body` e `pagination`; `pagination` aceita `compact`; `header` oferece slots `left`, `center` e `right`.
- Componentes de chat: use `chat-layout` como estrutura, `chat-sidebar` para conversas, `chat-conversation` para a conversa ativa, `chat-message` para bolhas e `chat-composer` para envio.

## Masked Fields

`phone`, `currency-br` and `cep` format values internally with Alpine inline handlers. They do not require an external Alpine mask plugin.

Examples:

```blade
<x-sampaui::phone name="phone" label="Telefone" wire:model.live="phone" />
<x-sampaui::currency-br name="price" label="Valor" wire:model.live="price" />
<x-sampaui::cep name="postal_code" label="CEP" wire:model.live="postal_code" />
```

`cep` formats `12345678` as `12345-678`.

## New Component Checklist

When adding or changing a component, update:

- `resources/views/components/{slug}.blade.php`
- `resources/metadata/components.php`
- `docs/{slug}.md`
- `docs/components.md`
- `docs/registry/components.json`
- `llms-full.txt`
- tests in `tests/Feature`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

Before release:

```bash
composer test
npm run build
git diff --check
```
